(2) The scene shifts to an outdoor street view showing a tall, modern building with a massive mural of a cartoon pig wearing a ceremonial belt. The sky is bright, and urban traffic signals are visible in the foreground. (3) Inside the shop, rows of merchandise including yellow mugs with cartoon pig logos and packaged food boxes are neatly arranged on wooden shelves under warm, even lighting. (4) Hands hold a physical menu featuring high-quality photos of pork cutlet dishes. The man points at a 'miso tonkatsu' dish while sitting at a wooden table with green tea in a glass. (5) A series of close-up shots show a plate of sliced pork rolls with green onions, followed by a chef pouring a thick, dark miso sauce over a freshly fried pork cutlet. Steam is visibly rising from the hot meat. (6) The man takes a large bite of the curry pork cutlet, closing his eyes in enjoyment and giving a thumbs-up. Yellow and white variety-style text overlays appear around him to emphasize his reaction. (7) A woman in a pink shirt and a red cap is seen sitting by a window, eating a large, long fried shrimp with chopsticks. In the background, other restaurant patrons are blurred. (8) The final sequence shows more close-ups of fried shrimp and pork cutlet pieces being dipped in sauce, ending with a text overlay providing the restaurant's address and contact information.
